issue.title: Embed build provenance in native release artifacts and refuse same-version staleness at publish
issue.body:
## What

Stamp a small provenance manifest (git commit SHA, build time) into the web assets that `build:cap` packs into the `.aab`/`.ipa`, and teach `npm run release:publish` to read it back out of the archive and refuse an artifact whose commit does not match the release tag's commit. Optionally report archive size against a named budget in the same check.

## Why

`tools/release/publish-release-artifacts.mjs` verifies embedded versionName/versionCode (ADR-0077), which blocks cross-version stale uploads — but it cannot detect a stale artifact of the *same* version, e.g. a bundle built before a late fix landed on the release commit. Commit-level provenance closes the freshness gap that version verification alone cannot; this is the remaining slice of #225.

## Where

- `web/defines.ts` / `web/vite.config.ts` already thread `__BUILD_TIME__`; emit a static `build-info.json` (commit + build time) into the native static export during `build:cap`
- `tools/release/lib/artifact-version.mjs` — extend archive inspection to read the manifest out of the `.aab`/`.ipa`
- `tools/release/publish-release-artifacts.mjs` — compare against the tag's commit and refuse mismatches with a diagnostic naming both commits
- `tools/release/tests/` — match, mismatch, and missing-manifest (pre-provenance artifact) cases

## Done when

- [ ] A freshly built `.aab`/`.ipa` carries the commit SHA and build time it was produced from.
- [ ] `npm run release:publish` (including `--dry-run`) refuses an artifact whose embedded commit does not match the release tag.
- [ ] Unit tests cover match, mismatch, and missing-manifest cases.

_Split from #225 during the 2026-08-16 overnight backlog triage._

comments.body:
A complete prototype of this issue is on `codex/issue-1098-native-build-provenance` at 0355943b2b05201f0819d5cfd0f0bc7365426bc7 (2026-08-19). It was local-only and has now been pushed so it isn't lost in a branch cleanup. It never became a PR.

What it does (19 files, +452/−97):

- Stamps build info (commit and build time) through `web/vite.config.ts` and `web/buildVersion.ts` into the static bundle that `build:cap` packs.
- `tools/release/lib/artifact-version.mjs` reads the stamp back out of the `.aab`/`.ipa`.
- `publish-release-artifacts` refuses an artifact whose commit doesn't match the tag's, with tests.

Against main on 2026-09-24 it conflicts in `package.json`, `tools/release/lib/artifact-version.mjs`, `tools/release/tests/artifact-version.test.mjs`, `tools/mobile/tests/static-bundle.test.mjs`, `web/buildVersion.ts`, and `web/vite.config.ts`, so expect to rebase or port it rather than merge it.
